regions.region: title, abstract, introduction, and lower-right Results and discussion
regions.finding: Abstract and introduction give high-level bromohydroxylation/bromination-elimination claims. The lower-right prose reports the 1h to 2h reaction at 85% and the 2-equiv Br2 isolation of 3h; these were linked to detailed cross-page records rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Page 1 does not provide complete procedures for either reaction.
Background cited chemistry was not converted into present-paper experiments.

regions.finding: Eight distinct bromohydroxylation conditions were extracted row by row, including the 0 °C footnote and the MeCN/EtOH plus 1-equiv-water override.
Three executed transformations were distinguished: direct 1h to 2h, isolation of 3h, and hydrolysis of 3h to 2h. Scheme yields were preserved alongside conflicting detailed-section yields.
ORTEP structures of 2c and cis-3h were linked as characterization evidence, not counted as additional reactions.
All three 3,3-disubstituted-allene bromination-elimination rows were extracted independently with selectivity values and the -40 °C row footnote.

unresolved: Table 1 and section 4.1 disagree on Br2 loading for both 1f entries.
The Table 2 entry-2 yield conflicts with the experimental paragraph.
Complex structures and stereochemistry remain unverified.

regions.finding: Exact substrate and Br2 quantities, product masses, and yields for Table 1 entries 1-8 were merged into the corresponding table rows; full workup/purification was retained only where explicitly printed.

unresolved: Abbreviated compound paragraphs generally omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and yield basis.
The 2g paragraph continues analytically onto page 4, but its reaction quantities and yield are complete on page 3.

regions.finding: The 1h to 2h experiment and all three Table 2 preparations were captured with printed quantities, conditions, masses, yields, workup/purification where stated, and source conflicts.
Isolation/recrystallization of 3h and its separate water reaction to 2h were extracted as two distinct experiments.
The paper states that supplementary data are online, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated; no SI-derived facts were inferred.

unresolved: Several reaction times and atmospheres are not reported.
Scheme and experimental-section yields conflict for 2h, 3h, and 4j.

regions.finding: No new present-paper experiment appears. References were treated as citations; crystal data for 2c and cis-3h were linked to their existing records as characterization context.

unresolved: Cited publications and deposited CCDC files were not supplied as associated sources and were not mined for experimental facts.
